faces._role: external input face, perpendicular to optical axis (Snell at this face is identity for normal incidence)
external output face for p-pol transmit (Snell identity)
external side exit face for s-pol reject. Outward normal +x, perpendicular to optical axis. Snell here refracts the in-crystal TIR-reflected beam into air.
INTERNAL gap interface (crystal-1 / air). Real surface normal at 38.5° from optical axis, tilted to direct s-pol TIR-reflection toward +x side. Used by glan_reject_s via mirror formula.
INTERNAL gap interface (air / crystal-2), parallel to B1, offset by air-gap thickness. p-pol transmits across B1+B2 with cancelling Snell refractions.

transitions._note: Forward p-pol transmission across both gap interfaces. Net Snell cancels for parallel-plate gap; matrix5x5 captures internal lateral shift + astigmatism. B_x = L/n_e + d_gap·(cos²θ_i/cos²θ_t − 1) = 3.38 + 0.12·3.052 = 3.74 mm. B_y = L/n_e = 3.38 mm.

Forward s-pol reject. Beam TIR-mirrors off B1 (in crystal-1), then Snell-refracts through A3 into air. Output direction emerges from mirror + Snell — NOT hard-coded. Expected air direction ≈ (0.928, 0, -0.374) with n_o = 1.66.
Reverse s-pol reject (rarely triggered — IO design assumes one-way input).

notes.topology: PBS-like beam splitter (NOT absorbing polarizer). 5 faces: A1 (input), A2 (transmit), A3 (side reject), B1 + B2 (internal gap interfaces). 4 transitions with multi-hop via chain. Power conservation T_p + T_s = 1.
notes.rejectGeometry: B1 normal (0.6225, 0, -0.7826) = (sin 38.5°, 0, -cos 38.5°), 38.5° from optical axis, outward toward source side. Mirror reflect of k=(0,0,1) gives k_crystal=(0.974, 0, -0.225) in crystal-1, then Snell at A3 (n_o=1.66 → 1) gives k_air≈(0.928, 0, -0.374). Reject exits BACKWARD in z (real Glan-Laser TIR behavior).
notes.tirCheck: sin 38.5° = 0.6225 > 1/n_o = 1/1.66 = 0.6024, so o-ray (s-pol) undergoes TIR at B1. e-ray (p-pol, n_e=1.486): sin 38.5° < 1/n_e = 0.673, so e-ray transmits across gap (no TIR).
notes.ExOffset: Augmented matrix E_x term (input-tilt-induced lateral shift): E_x ≈ L·θ_x_in·(1 − 1/n_e²) = 2.72·θ_x_in. Set to 0 here since matrix5x5 only encodes the slab+astigmatism; tracer doesn't yet thread input-tilt into E_x.
notes.variant: IO-3-850-HP has SMALLER crystal (L=5.0mm, 3mm clear aperture) than IO-5 (L=7.5mm, 5mm clear).
